text:
Maya (CSM): @team FYI - CedarTech showing stalled onboarding (2 weeks behind) and flagged for potential downgrade next invoice. Need a quick save plan.

Jordan (CSM Lead): Can you paste the last touchpoints and their blockers?

Maya (CSM): 1) Data connector failing on row-level permissions. 2) Low adoption of scheduled reports. Sent remediation notes 3 days ago, no reply.

Sam (Solutions Eng): I can take the connector ticket. Seen the logs? paste error: `504 upstream timeout` when syncing large CSVs.

Maya (CSM): @Sam that would be awesome. I'm also proposing a targeted enablement session for power users this week.

Lisa (Enablement): I can run a 45-min workshop Thurs 10am PT - focused on reports + retention dashboards. Will prep a short <5-step playbook> and a follow-up checklist.

Alan (CedarTech): Thanks all — we've been slammed. Connector issue would be priority. Workshop sounds good, Thurs works for 2 attendees.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Quick mitigation: increase chunk_size to 10k in the connector config and retry. Patch ETA 2h. I'll open a dedicated 1:1 and loop Alan.

healthbot: account_health: 62%, onboarding_progress: 58%, risk_level: medium-high. Last active: 3 days ago.

Maya (CSM): Plan: 1) Sam fixes connector now; 2) Lisa runs workshop Thurs; 3) I send a tailored ROI note + proposed short-term discount to avoid downgrade; 4) Collect feedback form after workshop.

Jordan (CSM Lead): Approve discount up to 15% for this renewal if adoption doesn't improve within 2 weeks. @Maya file the approval in the renewal thread.

Maya (CSM): Will do. Drafting the ROI note now, will attach the workshop invite and a 3-question feedback survey.

Lisa (Enablement): Feedback survey template:
```
1) Was the workshop helpful? (Y/N)
2) Which feature helped most?
3) Next top priority?
```

Alan (CedarTech): Happy to answer the survey after Thurs. Appreciate the quick response.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Connector PR merged. Patch deployed to staging. @Maya can you validate with Alan? If green, I'll schedule prod deploy later today.

Maya (CSM): Pinged Alan with staging link. Also added a calendar invite for Thurs 10am PT. :calendar:

Alan (CedarTech): Staging looks good. Reports generating. We'll be at the workshop.

Jordan (CSM Lead): Great. Follow-ups: Maya to update renewal thread with discount ask; Lisa to send survey; Sam to prod deploy; Maya to check adoption metrics 7 days after workshop. :thumbsup:

Maya (CSM): Noted. I'll post status update to #renewals and set a reminder for day 7.

healthbot: Updated: account_health: 74%, onboarding_progress: 70% (post-patch).

Maya (CSM): Closing loop here once we get survey results. Thanks team. :pray:
